name: com.hootonheroics.designsystem
description: A themeable UI Toolkit design system for Unity: design tokens (USS variables), a ScriptableObject theme, and ready-to-use components. Open-core, by Hooton Heroics.

samples.description: A demo panel showing the tokens + components.
A settings screen built from tabs, form controls, a dialog and toasts.
A game HUD: health and lives bars, a badge and toasts.
A pause menu: a card of buttons and a hold to quit button.
